title: Text: DET Mikaela Higgins ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Odd how
She called me and said she wasn't comfortable speaking about her experiences there - totally cool - but was hinting at there being a great story there
Then she texted me like 15 min later saying
Hey call me if you have a second - might have something for you!
And thennnn?
And basically, it was like, hey if you write this story, you might not be able to cover the Tigers or they might not let you in the press box again
And I'm like, you know I don't work for the Tigers, right?
What a weird conversation
Then what
And I didn't say this but I'm like...that's not how this works lol
What the fuck lol
Well after that I was kinda put off like, wtf? So I just said I mean, I guess we'll cross that bridge when we get there
And then was like well If you can help me, here's my number kinda thing
Thats fucking weird
It's weird that people don't understand the dynamic
I've learned that people are really stupid
So.. what now? Has anyone said anything
Not really. She was the only one that got back to my texts
Does Courtney know at all that I'm working on this?
I don't think so
